class.name: StudioEventDescription
class.brief_description: The description for an FMOD Studio event.

method.name: create_instance
method.description: Creates a playable instance.

method.name: get_id
method.description: Retrieves the GUID associated with the event.

method.name: get_instance_count
method.description: Retrieves the number of instances.

method.name: get_instance_list
method.description: Retrieves a list of the instances.

method.name: get_length
method.description: Retrieves the length of the timeline.

method.name: get_max_distance
method.description: Retrieves the maximum distances for 3D attenuation.

method.name: get_min_distance
method.description: Retrieves the minimum distances for 3D attenuation.

method.name: get_parameter_description_count
method.description: Retrieves the number of parameters in the event.

method.name: get_parameter_label_by_id
method.description: Retrieves an event parameter label by ID.

method.name: get_parameter_label_by_index
method.description: Retrieves an event parameter label by index.

method.name: get_parameter_label_by_name
method.description: Retrieves an event parameter label by name, including the path

method.name: get_path
method.description: Retrieves the path.

method.name: get_sample_loading_state
method.description: Retrieves the sample data loading state.

method.name: get_sound_size
method.description: Retrieves the sound size for 3D panning.

method.name: get_user_property
method.description: Retrieves a user property by name.

method.name: get_user_property_by_index
method.description: Retrieves a user property by index.

method.name: get_user_property_count
method.description: Retrieves the number of user properties attached to the event.

method.name: has_sustain_point
method.description: Retrieves whether the event has any sustain points.

method.name: is3D
method.description: Retrieves the event's 3D status.

method.name: is_doppler_enabled
method.description: Retrieves the event's doppler status.

method.name: is_oneshot
method.description: Retrieves the event's oneshot status.

method.name: is_snapshot
method.description: Retrieves the event's snapshot status.

method.name: is_stream
method.description: Retrieves the event's stream status.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Checks that the EventDescription reference is valid.

method.name: load_sample_data
method.description: Loads non-streaming sample data used by the event.

method.name: release_all_instances
method.description: Releases all instances.

method.name: unload_sample_data
method.description: Unloads all non-streaming sample data.
